issue_context.title: Convert THROW_IF_NULL_ALLOC for input parameters to return E_INVALIDARG not E_OUTOFMEMORY.
issue_context.body:
This isn't exactly correct, it'll result in a hresult exception `E_OUTOFMEMORY` or whatever. It's really more of an invalid parameter, but also it's more of a "we could avoid the throwing constructor completely" case?

_Originally posted by @DHowett-MSFT in https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/pull/4005_

I had said we should bulk do this all over the codebase.

review_comments: I don't think this should throw `E_INVALIDARG`. So I choose `E_FAIL`. Any advice?
